remarks: Welcome to this luxurious ranch, custom built only 2 years ago! This sprawling home gives ease and luxury to first floor living, and is completely move-in ready! Enter the living area, open concept and full of bright natural light from the windows, with recessed lighting dotting across the ceiling. The luxury vinyl plank flooring runs throughout the home, and leads seamlessly to the dining area and kitchen. The kitchen is every chef's dream, with quartz countertops, a big island and breakfast bar, pantry, plenty of cabinet space, and high end appliances. Matte black finishes throughout the home give a cohesive, modern feel. There is a bonus room, currently used as an office, but can also be a playroom or home gym. Powder room off the kitchen is perfect for guests. All three bedrooms are a great size with big closets. The primary suite boasts a walk-in closet and ensuite bath that features a tiled walk-in shower with rainfall shower head. The full basement includes egress to the outside for potential additional living space. Outside, you are surrounded by privacy, with a tree-lined backyard an no rear neighbors. Not to mention- just steps away from the Erie Canalway Trail for beautiful morning walks. This home could be your very own private sanctuary.
